items.title: Gene muntaqil karne ke tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the methods of gene transfer (PDF 162-163).

blocks.text: Gene (DNA) ko target cell (jis cell mein gene dalna hai) mein us ki cell membrane ya cell wall ke raaste dala jata hai, aur cell ko tabah nahin kiya jata. Poora multicellular (bohat se cells wala) GMO banane ke liye gene ko gamete ya gametes banane wale tissue mein dala jata hai. Phir aise gametes ko aapas mein mila (fuse kar) kar GMOs banaye jate hain. Gene of interest ko target cell mein dalne ke aam tareeqe yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Chhe khane, har aik mein aik cell: electroporation (bijli ka jhatka pores kholta), microinjection (barik sui nucleus tak), biolistic (heavy metal se lipta gene, gene gun), protoplast tareeqa (cell wall hatayi, protoplast DNA wale medium mein), kimiyai tareeqa (DNA aur kimiyai maadda, endocytosis) aur virus ke zariye (virus gene le jata).
blocks.caption: Gene ko cell mein dalne ke chhe tareeqe (kitab ki fehrist (a)-(f) ke liye hamara asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi figure nahi).

blocks.text: (a) Electroporation mein bijli ke current se target cell ki cell wall ya cell membrane mein chhote soorakh (pores) banaye jate hain. In soorakhon se gene andar chala jata hai. Jab bijli ka current khatam hota hai to soorakh band ho jate hain.
(b) Microinjection mein bohat bareek sui (fine needle) se gene ko seedha target cell ke nucleus mein inject kiya jata hai.

(c) Biolistic transformation mein gene of interest ko heavy metal (aam taur par sona ya tungsten) ke bohat chhote zarron (particles) par chadha kar mechanical taqat, maslan gene gun, se target cell mein daaga jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke gene “heavy metal ions” se coated hota hai. Asal mein DNA heavy metal ke nanhe zarron (particles), aam taur par sone ya tungsten, par chadhaya jata hai; ions ko gene gun se nahin daaga ja sakta.

(d) Protoplast mediated technique mein target cell ki cell wall hata di jati hai. Is tarah bana protoplast (wall ke baghair cell) aise medium mein milaya jata hai jis mein gene of interest ho, aur DNA cell membrane ke raaste andar chala jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke cell wall aur cell membrane dono hata di jati hain. Protoplast woh cell hai jis ki sirf cell wall hatayi gayi ho; cell membrane qaim rehti hai, warna cell zinda hi nahin rahega.

(e) Chemical methods mein naked DNA (khula DNA) ko kisi chemical agent ke saath mila diya jata hai. Chemical aur DNA ka yeh complex diffusion ya endocytosis (cell ka cheez ko nigalna) ke zariye cell ke cytoplasm mein chala jata hai.
(f) Virus mediated gene transfer mein Adenovirus, Adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus aur doosre retroviruses gene ko cell tak pohanchane ke liye istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Sakht cell wall wale paude ke cell mein, sui ke baghair, gene dalne ka kaun sa tareeqa munasib hoga?
blocks.explanation: Biolistic transformation: gene gun DNA chadhe metal ke zarron ko wall ke paar daag deta hai. Doosra raasta protoplast technique hai, jis mein pehle cell wall hata di jati hai.

items: Gene cell ko tabah kiye baghair cell membrane ya cell wall ke raaste dala jata hai; poore GMO ke liye gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein.
Tareeqe: electroporation (bijli se pores), microinjection (bareek sui), biolistic (gene gun, metal ke zarre), protoplast (wall hata kar), chemical methods, virus mediated.
